title: Funny Astronomy Heavy Cotton T-Shirt, Its Nice Being Third, Minimalist Solar System Tee
description:
It’s nice being third.

This funny astronomy shirt features a clean, minimalist illustration of the solar system with a subtle joke about Earth’s place as the third planet from the Sun. Nothing points to Earth or gives away the punchline—it’s quietly hiding in plain sight.

A fun conversation-starting shirt for astronomy lovers, science teachers, STEM students, space enthusiasts, planet lovers, and anyone who enjoys understated humor.

PRODUCT FEATURES

• Gildan 5000 Heavy Cotton T-shirt
• Classic unisex fit
• Medium-weight 180 g/m² fabric
• Solid colors are 100% cotton
• Tubular construction with no side seams
• Ribbed collar helps retain its shape
• Shoulder tape provides additional durability
• Tear-away label
• Detailed direct-to-garment printed design
• OEKO-TEX® certified
• Made using ethically sourced US cotton
• Intended for adults

FIT AND SIZING

This is a classic-fit T-shirt, not an oversized or boxy garment. Choose your usual size for a traditional T-shirt fit. For a roomier appearance, consider sizing up one size.

Please compare the garment measurements in the size chart with a shirt you already own before ordering.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS

• Machine wash cold, maximum 30°C or 90°F
• Use non-chlorine bleach only when needed
• Tumble dry on low heat
• Do not iron
• Do not dry clean

MADE TO ORDER

Every shirt is printed especially for you after your order is placed. Slight differences in color and print placement may occur because of monitor settings, garment sizes, and the made-to-order printing process.

Original concept and creative direction by HomeFromWorking. AI-assisted tools were used during the illustration and refinement process. The finished garment is printed, packaged, and shipped by a disclosed production partner.
